Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, which totals 18.0 days across a full plan year.

Next steps:
- Review your MosaicOne balance
- Contact People Operations with questions

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Retirement plan eligibility is different: an employee may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make benefits elections in MosaicOne Benefits. An employee who makes no election within that window is enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one
- Make elections within 30 days of day 90

Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for bulk personal-data extracts over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

The security team answers every phishing report, including the ones that turn out to be legitimate mail, and publishes a short monthly summary of what was seen.

Next steps:
- Forward to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply or act

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claims by month-end for next payroll

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement. Parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service.

Next steps:
- Confirm your service start date with People Operations
- Review leave timing requirements with your manager

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the standard cap cannot be met—a remote field site with one hotel or a sold-out market—the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason; no pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Book lodging through MosaicOne Travel
- Note reason if cap cannot be met

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure and must name the destination, exact dates, workspace address and a description of the work to be performed.

A review has one of three outcomes: Approved, Approved with conditions (most often a prohibition on customer-facing activity and a hard end date), or Not approved.

A trip exceeding 30 consecutive days requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

The employee must hold the right to work in the destination country for the whole of the requested period. Mosaic Robotics does not sponsor visas for temporary work abroad.

Work must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure.

The device and network requirements in the Security & Acceptable Use Policy apply in full, including always-on VPN whenever a company device connects to a network that Mosaic Robotics does not control, and screens showing Confidential or Restricted material must not be visible to other people.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review 21 days ahead
- Obtain director and manager approvals
- Notify IT Security 5 business days prior

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports up to USD 2,500 are approved by the direct manager.

Next steps:
- Book flights 14 days ahead via MosaicOne Travel
- Submit expense report with itemised receipts to manager
- Confirm lodging meets USD 250/night cap

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

The full required training set for every employee includes security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one, and the new hire has 30 days from the end of the 90-day waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Standard equipment including laptop, adapter, headset, monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock is shipped to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Finish all required training by day 30
- Make benefits elections within 30 days of 90-day waiting period end

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

An early laptop refresh requires direct manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment. IT sends a prepaid, tracked shipping label to remote employees before their final day, and onsite employees hand equipment to their local IT desk.

Next steps:
- Contact your manager to approve the refresh
- Coordinate timing with IT through MosaicOne
- Return equipment within 5 business days of separation

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours. Severity 1 covers immediate risk to a person: violence or a threat of it, a safety incident with injury, a credible risk of self-harm, sexual misconduct involving physical contact, and any matter where someone must be separated from a situation today.

Target resolution time for Severity 1 cases is as fast as the facts allow. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update. Updates continue at least every 10 business days until the case closes.

Next steps:
- Contact Employee Relations for harassment, discrimination, or retaliation reports
- Report through MosaicOne or contact People Operations for other concerns
- Review the Workplace Conduct Policy for full process details

You are assigned to the Boston office and are expected to be on site at least 3 days each week as a hybrid employee.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your manager is Dana (Director, Engineering).

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Unforeseeable absences — a sudden illness, a family emergency, a transport failure that makes work impossible — are never held to the notice requirement. The employee notifies their manager as early as they reasonably can, and the absence is entered in MosaicOne retroactively, against sick time where the reason was illness and against PTO otherwise.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager. Longer requests and requests overlapping a blackout period additionally require director approval, and the notice periods below come from the PTO & Holidays Policy.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your PTO balance as of 2026-09-01 is 13.5 days remaining, with your next accrual on 2026-10-01. Your accrual rate is 1.5 days per month.

Recommendation — not company policy: For questions about your balance or to report any discrepancies, contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example or use MosaicOne's Report a balance issue form.

Next steps:
- Submit PTO requests in MosaicOne with appropriate notice
- Contact People Operations for balance questions
- Review blackout dates (2026-12-22 to 2026-12-23)

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Every PTO request requires written approval from the employee's direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your PTO balance as of 2026-09-01 is 13.5 days, which covers your 3-day request. You have sufficient accrual. Submit your request in MosaicOne now to allow the required 5 business days' notice before Tuesday 15 September, and obtain your manager Dana's written approval.

Next steps:
- Submit PTO request in MosaicOne immediately
- Obtain manager approval in writing
- Confirm 5 business days' notice is met

A stay of 30 consecutive days or fewer in an approved country requires manager approval under the Remote & Hybrid Work Policy and nothing further from Tax & Legal.

Ireland is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay from 1 October to 20 October 2026 is 20 consecutive calendar days, which falls within the 30-day threshold.

Work abroad up to 30 consecutive days in an approved country requires direct manager approval only, with no second approver.

Recommendation — not company policy: You do not need Tax & Legal review for this trip. Obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure by raising the request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country', naming the destination, exact dates, and workspace address.

You must still use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN, notify IT Security of the destination at least 5 business days before departure, and ensure the 20 days count against your rolling 90-day annual limit.

Next steps:
- Request manager approval in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days ahead.
- Notify IT Security of Ireland destination 5 business days before 1 October.
- Confirm your travel laptop meets device and VPN requirements.

You have 45 months of tenure as of 2026-09-01, exceeding the 12-month minimum required to work outside your home country.

Your 42-day stay (3 November to 14 December) exceeds the 30-day threshold and requires director approval and a Tax & Legal review filed at least 21 calendar days before departure.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your 42-day stay fits within the rolling 90-day annual limit for work outside your home country.

You must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN, and IT Security must be notified of Germany at least 5 business days before departure.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while in Germany; Tax & Legal review typically approves extended stays with conditions including a hard end date and prohibition on customer-facing activity.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates, workspace address, and work description at least 21 calendar days before 3 November.

Recommendation — not company policy: File the Tax & Legal review request alongside manager approval; director approval is required for stays over 30 days.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm your travel laptop meets encryption and VPN requirements with IT Security before departure.

Next steps:
- Raise request in MosaicOne with dates and workspace address
- File Tax & Legal review at least 21 days before departure
- Notify IT Security 5 business days before travel
